title: Russia Fires 310 Drones the Day After Mass Energy Strike
detail: Overnight Nov 3-4 Russia attacked with 310 drones; the Air Force says 272 were downed or jammed, with hits recorded at 19 locations. DTEK reported three of its thermal power plants were significantly damaged and stopped generating. The attack followed the Nov 2-3 strike on the energy grid.

media.caption: Russia fires 310 drones at Ukraine day after mass strike on energy grid
